mapper.sql: t.cntc_sn AS "sn",t.cntc_stat_cd AS "status",t.cntc_memo AS "memo",t.cntc_dt AS "contactDate", t.reg_user_id AS "actorId",COALESCE(u.user_nm,t.reg_user_id) AS "actorName"
mapper.select: SELECT cand_id AS "id",cntc_stat_cd AS "status",last_cntc_dt AS "lastContactDate" FROM tb_hr_cand WHERE cand_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM tb_hr_cand_cntc t LEFT JOIN tb_sy_user u ON u.user_id=t.reg_user_id WHERE t.cand_id=#{id} ORDER BY t.cntc_dt DESC,t.cntc_sn DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM tb_hr_cand_cntc WHERE cand_id=#{id}
SELECT COALESCE(max(cntc_sn),0) FROM tb_hr_cand_cntc WHERE cand_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM tb_hr_cand_cntc t LEFT JOIN tb_sy_user u ON u.user_id=t.reg_user_id WHERE t.cand_id=#{id} AND t.cntc_sn=#{sn}
